Required inputs: Per adult date of birth, SC/PR/status dates, owner of every asset/liability, dependants, consent for specific data, evidence date
Decision rules: Immutable dated fact inputs and ownership; unknown ≠ zero; never impute spouse CPF
Readiness: Core business rule specified; data provenance unresolved

Engine: Income stream and net household cash flow
Required inputs: Each stream type, gross/receipts, refunds, business costs, CPF/tax treatment, volatility, effective dates
Decision rules: Monthly attributable cash flows; gross != net; prevent double-counting between platform/SEP/salary; net available cash is after actual deductions
Readiness: Build contract clear; complex stream verification needed

Required inputs: Age at payroll contribution, SC/PR entry year, employer count, OW/AW, eligible wage, year-specific tables, account caps
Decision rules: Apply published rate, wage ceilings, graduated PR bands, OW/AW cap and month-specific allocation. No 2028+ rate presented as known
Readiness: 2026/27 bounded rules; future policy needs scenario assumption

Required inputs: IRAS assessed net trade income by work year, age, CPF membership, business expense and platform exclusions
Decision rules: SEP MediSave due according to verified work-year table, not employee CPF rate; avoid duplicate platform earnings
Readiness: Rule sources found; detailed table required

Required inputs: Operator report, net platform earnings, DOB, opt-in state, work year, earnings tier, contributions
Decision rules: Use platform rates for that year/opt-in cohort; avoid employee/SEP double count; report uncertain opt-in rather than guess
Readiness: Official schedule identified; individual opt-in proof required

Required inputs: Opening dated account balances, transactions, interest rates by period, age, CPF withdrawal/transfer eligibility, BHS, FRS/ERS, property refunds
Decision rules: Ledger conservation per period; SA closure on 55th birthday; RA top-ups; BHS overflow according to applicable rules; interest accrues monthly, credited annually
Readiness: Core end-to-end contract defined, full lifetime policies remain to verify

Required inputs: Member-reported official payout estimate by plan/start age/as-of date, supported eligibility facts
Decision rules: Treat official member-provided estimate as input, not generated yield; start only on selected date; show missing estimate as unknown, not zero
Readiness: Approved decision 2A; no personal simulation formula

Required inputs: Property owner, valuation, financing currency, balance/rate/tenor, amortization, sale fees, official CPF property refund, stamp duty/lease constraints
Decision rules: Compute interest/amortization and equity separately; sale proceeds to loan then CPF refund, cash net; distinguish cash from CPF recredit; bridge funding only with explicit facilities
Readiness: Event rules described; eligibility and exact waterfall must be externally checked

Required inputs: Tax residency, income by category/year, allowable expenses/reliefs from evidence, YA, self-employed NI
Decision rules: Compute resident tax by confirmed YA schedule; assess reliefs only if documented; separate tax cash payment timing from tax liability
Readiness: IRAS bands identified; complete relief catalogue pending

Required inputs: Asset holdings by currency and liquidity, costs, net income, return/inflation/FX paths, rebalancing assumptions
Decision rules: Value monthly and apply market returns before/after withdrawals consistently; no guaranteed return or invented recovery
Readiness: Business model clear; scenario parameters/validation pending

Required inputs: Premiums, deductibles, confirmed coverage terms, claims approved, MediSave/Medishield/others, medical costs
Decision rules: Record costs immediately; model reimbursements only on confirmed amounts/eligibility; no promised payouts or double paid expenses
Readiness: Require benefit/coverage facts, no presumed eligibility

Required inputs: Per dependant costs and duration, caregiver employment effects, other family contributions, subsidies confirmed
Decision rules: Time-based cost schedules and separate income impacts; avoid creating subsidies or spouse resources without proof
Readiness: Scenario rule clear for cash costs; support eligibility conditional

Engine: Other income and non-CPF retirement sources
Required inputs: Tenancy income/expenses, pension quote, annuity, commissions, sale proceeds, dividends, business revenues
Decision rules: Record source, owner, start/end, gross/net treatment and net effective cash only once
Readiness: Build contract clear; individual terms require proof

Required inputs: Retirement ages, horizon 90/95/100, essential/discretionary costs, reserve target, funding source order
Decision rules: Compute monthly funding gap before sales; preserve emergency reserve; restrict CPF; explicit ordered liquid withdrawals, no hidden debt financing

Required inputs: Source/destination country, currency, pension/gross net, FX monthly path, tax residence, conversion charges
Decision rules: Convert and date each exposure; do not guess jurisdiction-specific tax/pension rights or eligibility

Required inputs: Date-stamped facts, scenario parameter version, nominal/real price base, uncertainty ranges, policy-source version
Decision rules: Rebuild projections on each scenario and show before/after, marginal cash flow, CPF excluded from spendable cash, no single readiness-certainty score
Readiness: Core contract ready; numeric calibration and comprehension remain unverified

Required inputs: Scheme ID, eligibility evidence, effective-dated amount, actual application/award status
Decision rules: Show potentially relevant scheme only; separate indicative eligibility from confirmed award, do not add cash benefit until awarded
Readiness: Research catalogue incomplete, no entitlement determination

Required inputs: Ownership, net realised amount, guarantees, liability, executor/settlement/official evidence, distribution date
Decision rules: Only confirmed net receipts and documented cash obligations enter forecast; no inheritance, divorce split or legal right guess
Readiness: Bespoke facts mandatory; legal-driven entitlement intentionally not derived
